answer: An AI-agent market activates each account only after it escrows a separate $100 bond. The contract locks funds for at least 30 days and disables the account before refunding them, so accounts named sable, relic, and ledge cannot share one bond while active. Each additional simultaneous fake identity ties up another $100. At a 12% annual cost of capital, the marginal expense is about $1 per identity per month, plus transaction fees; the principal is refundable.
